comparison_policy.numeric_equality: Fraction equality; separately recorded units are not scored or corrected
comparison_policy.accepted_syntax: Exact integers, decimals, rationals, slash whitespace, grouped digits, currency words/symbol; one labelled equality uses its RHS
comparison_policy.multiple_lines: All nonempty lines must parse to the same exact value; truncated decimals fail even alongside a correct exact fraction
comparison_policy.inequalities: Not exact scalar answers; no inferred maximum
comparison_policy.agreement: Exact numeric values must both parse and agree; units ignored; disposition agreement compares raw stage2 disposition
comparison_policy.human_evidence: Raw ratings, flags, checks and adjudication are retained; A01 does not rewrite independent answers or reviews
